defn: Iris melanoma characterized by the presence of intermediate cells which are similar to but smaller than epithelioid cells.

name: iris melanoma
defn: A uveal melanoma that arises from the iris. It is the most common primary malignant neoplasm of the iris. The majority arise in preexisting nevi.

name: intermediate cell type choroid melanoma
syn: intermediate cell type uveal melanoma of optic choroid
optic choroid intermediate cell type uveal melanoma
defn: Choroid melanoma characterized by the presence of intermediate cells which are similar to but smaller than epithelioid cells.
